description: Daily open, high, low, close and volume of one listing of a company, newest session first, built from trades executed at IEX only. IEX is a single exchange with a small share of US volume: this is not the consolidated tape, close is the last IEX trade of the session and not the official closing price, volume is IEX volume only, and nothing is adjusted for splits or dividends. Say so when you quote a number, and show the citation in meta.attribution. For P/E, market capitalisation and other multiples use ratios_daily, which pairs each close with the facts known that day and withholds points after a likely split. ticker picks another listing of the company; from and to bound the session dates; as_of replays what was known on a date; cursor pages. Every number carries a proof naming the IEX session file it was read from.

adjust.description: splits: each bar also carries split_adjusted values (confirmed splits after the session only); total_return: also total_return values, dividends reinvested at the IEX close before each ex-date (only dividends with an ex-date in the filings).

as_of.description: Knowledge date or timestamp (YYYY-MM-DD or RFC 3339). The answer is what FinancialMD knew at that instant: only facts whose known interval contains as_of. Omit for the current view.

company.description: Company identifier: a FinancialMD id ("fmd_01H..."), an SEC CIK ("cik:320193"), or a ticker ("ticker:AAPL", optionally with the MIC "ticker:AAPL.XNAS"). A bare ticker like "AAPL" is accepted and sent as ticker:AAPL. An issuer on an EU or UK regulated market that does not file with the SEC has no CIK: pass its LEI ("lei:IOG4E947OATN0KJYSD45") or its fmd_ id.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page (data.next_cursor).

limit.description: Maximum number of periods or items to return (default 30, at most 1000).

ticker.description: Optional ticker of another listing of the same company (BRK.B). Default: the ticker in company, else the primary listing.

name: stock_prices

outputSchema.description: The FinancialMD envelope (docs/API.md section 2): data plus meta (request_id, as_of knowledge time, matched company, coverage, pipeline_version, licence, terms, proof_base). Every numeric value inside data is an object with value, unit, currency, period, known interval, restated flag, method and a proof pointing at the filing. On failure the result is isError with an error object instead.

data.description: { items: [{ date, open, high, low, close, volume, has_broken_print }], next_cursor, listing: { ticker, mic, currency, is_primary } | null, listings, source: { id, venue, consolidated: false, adjusted: false, attribution, attribution_url, notes }, range: { from, to, sessions } }; open, high, low, close and volume are value objects. meta.attribution carries the citation the venue requires.

error.description: Present only on isError results: the API error code and message plus remedy hints.

meta.description: Request metadata: request_id, as_of, company resolution, coverage, pipeline_version, licence, terms, proof_base.

attribution.description: Citations a source requires on anything shown from the answer.

title: Daily prices (IEX only)
